text: This report recommends that the name "Ratna Lane" be approved to identify a private lane in Regent Park located north of Dundas Street East, extending between Sumach Street and River Street. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its February 24, 2021 meeting.
